apptainer.blocker: pod securityContext blocks mount propagation: 'mount --make-rprivate /' -> Permission denied; apptainer 'Failed to set mount propagation: Permission denied'. Not fixable without k8s privileges.

udocker.viability_for_fmriprep: NOT VIABLE for research-grade run: proot ptrace overhead (~5-50x) over 8 subj + ~200 rest runs is prohibitively slow/fragile; udocker is an unsupported fMRIPrep runtime -> correctness risk for geometric preprocessing feeding frozen O2.3C.

freesurfer_license.obtainable: free registration at surfer.nmr.mgh.harvard.edu/registration.html (external credential; cannot be obtained autonomously)
freesurfer_license.note: NSD FreeSurfer subjects exist (nsddata/freesurfer) and can be reused via --fs-subjects-dir, avoiding recon-all, but the license file is still mandatory at startup.

conclusion: Neither preprocessing lane is executable in a supported, research-grade manner in the current environment: Lane A lacks MATLAB; Lane B (fMRIPrep 25.2.5) cannot run under the only supported runtime (apptainer, blocked by pod mount restriction) and requires an absent FreeSurfer license. udocker/proot is technically able to run containers but is not a supportable fMRIPrep runtime.
enablers_needed_to_proceed: A STABLE, container-capable execution host: non-preemptible, with Docker OR Apptainer/Singularity permitted to set up mounts, and persistent writable storage for the ~20GB image + fMRIPrep outputs. (The current preemptible pod cannot host fMRIPrep.)
A FreeSurfer license.txt placed on persistent storage (free registration; external credential).

image_acquisition_attempt.official_image_tag_exists: nipreps/fmriprep:25.2.5 confirmed on Docker Hub (latest release)
image_acquisition_attempt.udocker_pull: FAILS on the large fMRIPrep layer (sha256:660ffc76...): NFS store -> 'delete not owner' (root_squash) then hang at 5GB; local overlay store -> zombie curl, stalls at 30MB. udocker downloader unreliable for the ~15GB layer.
image_acquisition_attempt.skopeo_copy: installed skopeo 1.24.0 (conda-forge); after fixing v1->v2 registries.conf + --insecure-policy it transfers robustly, BUT the pod preempted mid-copy at ~2.7GB of ~20GB; ephemeral local overlay (/home/jovyan) is wiped on rollout so the tar is lost.
image_acquisition_attempt.nfs_pvc_container_store: UNUSABLE for container images: root_squash makes udocker/skopeo layer files owned by nobody -> 'delete not owner'.
image_acquisition_attempt.local_overlay_store: 431G disk /101G free but EPHEMERAL -> wiped on the frequent pod rollouts.

pod_preemption_observed.pattern: pod cycled up/down multiple times this session; uptime windows only ~tens of minutes; port22 DOWN/refused between.
pod_preemption_observed.impact: defeats even a ~20-min image copy; a multi-hour fMRIPrep run (min. needed for this gate) cannot survive; ephemeral working storage is wiped each rollout.

decisive_conclusion: Lane B (fMRIPrep 25.2.5) CANNOT be executed to completion on this pod: no supported container runtime (apptainer blocked by securityContext; no docker/singularity; no sudo); only udocker/proot runs (slow/unsupported) and its downloader fails on the large layer; robust skopeo transfer + any sustained compute are defeated by frequent preemption that wipes ephemeral storage, while the persistent NFS PVC's root_squash breaks container image stores; plus the FreeSurfer license is still absent. This is an infrastructure limitation, not a scientific result.
